description: Create an aviation runway-allocation standard-library module with ordered resource acquisition and deadlock prevention. The generated module MUST define a RunwayAllocation state machine with Idle -> Ordered -> Allocated transitions, resource hierarchy declarations for runway_primary (priority 1) and runway_secondary (priority 2), and atoms that acquire runway resources in priority order.

atoms.name: allocate_runway
atoms.description: Ordered runway allocation with deadlock prevention
atoms.requires: flight >= 0 && runway1 >= 0 && runway2 >= 0 && runway1 != runway2 && runway1 < runway2
atoms.body_pattern: perform RunwayAllocation.order; acquire runway_primary { acquire runway_secondary { perform RunwayAllocation.allocate; runway1 + runway2 } }
